# High Roller Technologies Highlights ROLR™ Election Tracker Featuring Live Odds for the 2026 Midterms


November 02, 2026 3:05 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_6db790e3c1b4ca55e291ac82bb1fea5b/highroller/news/2026-11-02_High_Roller_Technologies_Highlights_ROLR_Election__172.pdf)


*Interactive website brings together live prediction market odds, congressional control indicators and competitive races in one destination*


LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[High Roller Technologies, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Hcu77wfI2TNdOgHucMBkzZbLT3xIE90L4UDMXG_XSP-o0sjg-1LR8OQHLYmYco7MSIbjtN9_a0870XaPPXWVfuwApO9a5EiknldvWUr23WE=) (“High Roller” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ROLR), an online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced today highlighted its election tracking website,[elections.rolr.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GQvSlf-OD0EViNeBE11fj7MpxijVANwq8foZXeXkPT47QGIeevrmWcMcayhr0rz540oeNgxBer38w1lDQ_LkkmQ3wOoTeqHnZfyDefLiG9k=) , providing an interactive view of prediction market expectations for the 2026 U.S. midterm elections.


As Americans head to the polls, the ROLR™ election dashboard offers a convenient destination to follow shifting market odds for control of the U.S. House of Representatives and Senate, explore individual congressional and gubernatorial races, and identify the closest contests and biggest changes in market expectations.


“Election Day brings an enormous amount of information, and people want an intuitive way to understand what’s changing and which races matter,” said Seth Young, Chief Executive Officer of High Roller Technologies. “Our election dashboard brings the prediction market perspective into one accessible experience, from the national balance of power to individual races. It’s also a compelling introduction to ROLR, helping people discover the markets behind the numbers and follow the outcomes that interest them.”


The website’s features include:


- **Balance-of-power indicators:** Visual gauges display market odds for House and Senate control, alongside market-derived estimates of Senate seats, the House popular-vote margin and net gubernatorial pickups.
- **Interactive election maps:** Visitors can explore tracked Senate, House and gubernatorial contests by state and select individual races for additional detail.
- **Closest races and biggest movers:** Dedicated sections highlight competitive contests and the largest changes in race odds over the preceding 24 hours, where historical data are available.
- **Search, filters and watchlists:** Users can search by state, district or market, filter by election category and save markets to a watchlist.
- **Price histories and market access:** Charts show how contract prices have changed, with links to the corresponding markets on ROLR for eligible customers.


The dashboard updates as new quotes arrive from ROLR, allowing visitors to follow how market expectations evolve throughout Election Day and as the electoral picture develops.


The displayed odds and estimates reflect prediction market prices and the dashboard’s calculations; they are not official election results or guarantees of an outcome. Data are provided for informational purposes and may be delayed or incorrect.


Explore the election dashboard at[elections.rolr.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GQvSlf-OD0EViNeBE11fjycFg8JIsC7Bbt7Z5d1CJo0cMbkRG6QtmqCeHJxqFex0RKWoBcX3O-jsP7Crc6vo2Sb3j_3xm09lHMYnIm-VsJQ=) . To learn more about ROLR and available prediction markets, visit[rolr.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=O4kuzpJ7zGzTvHu-Tzxk6Nu75_f9eJbsjgUKlUtIQk4dMI78grtOw3C9rbfJBXHFbfzLQGIk0ofkT5kKFzEuRg==) .
